categories.label: Guilt
categories.description: Pressure that makes refusal feel cruel, selfish, disloyal, or morally wrong.

categories.label: Identity
categories.description: Pressure that makes compliance a test of who you are or how others should see you.

categories.label: Urgency
categories.description: Pressure that compresses decision time so pausing, refusing, or reflecting feels unavailable.

categories.label: Desire / Pacing
categories.description: Pressure around desire, consent, escalation, reversibility, and the ability to slow down or stop.

categories.label: Work / Power
categories.description: Pressure that uses hierarchy, career consequences, status, or deniable authority.

categories.label: Family / Obligation
categories.description: Pressure that converts family role, loyalty, gratitude, or history into automatic availability.
